boundary: Selected measured-redshift cohort audit; exchangeability and host-label validity remain assumptions. CHIME transport and hierarchy specificity are unestablished.

protocol.calibration_rule: Absolute comoving-distance error order statistic ceil((n_cal+1)*coverage), including failed predictions as positive-infinite scores. Rank beyond n_cal gives an unbounded interval. Clamp lower distance to zero. Test prediction failures remain uncovered operational outcomes.
protocol.exchangeability: The finite localized survey cohort is selected by host identification and redshift acquisition. Survey frequency, sensitivity, follow-up and a partly shared host-offset prior vary. Randomized-source-style fixed hash partitioning avoids deliberate outcome selection; an IID or exchangeable superpopulation remains an assumption, not an observed fact.
protocol.finite_sample_boundary: Eleven calibration sources produce ranks10,11,12 for coverage0.8,0.9,0.95. The95 percent interval is unbounded. With ten held-out sources the primary binomial test rejects only coverage counts<=6; even10/10 cannot establish a population coverage rate of at least0.9.
protocol.foreground_identifiability: Nine halo/observer-host pairs yield five distinct summed subtractions:0,50,100,150,200. Equal totals must produce identical predictions and calibration quantiles. The comparison identifies neither separate halo nor host contributions.
protocol.measurement_policy: DM measurement errors are retained from the primary table. Missing redshift, Galactic, halo and host uncertainty distributions remain unmodeled. Calibration targets published redshift point labels; bounds are empirical prediction intervals, not propagated measurement-error posteriors.
protocol.partition_rule: Sort SHA256(UTF8(split_salt + ':' + source_id)) ascending with source_id tie-break; first 11 sources calibrate and remaining 10 test. Freeze membership independently of DM, redshift and outcomes.
protocol.pre_execution_clarification: Independent review clarifies zero-residual treatment and foreground non-identifiability before calibration residual execution. Source membership, partition, model constants and outcome rules retain their frozen values.
protocol.precision_policy: Report absolute errors and interval widths alongside comparisons with all four historical neighborhood radii. These comparisons assess scale mismatch and supply no application-derived usefulness threshold.
protocol.predictor: Planck2018 constant-fd mean-DM inverse of observed DM minus NE2001 disk DM minus scenario halo minus fixed observer-frame host. The predictor consumes no measured redshift. Halo50 follows the source convention; observer-host50 is the retained computational predictor, not a claim of universal physical host DM.
protocol.predictor_domain: Cosmic residual must be strictly positive, matching the FRB CLI selection convention. Exact zero, negative residuals and numerical inversion errors are retained prediction failures. Calibration failure scores are positive infinity; held-out failures count uncovered.
protocol.primary_outcome: Report the primary 90 percent artifact's held-out coverage and two-sided95 percent Clopper-Pearson interval; a one-sided Binomial(n_test,0.9) lower-tail p below0.05 flags undercoverage under the stated independent common-coverage model. Otherwise report undercoverage not detected, rather than proof of calibration.
protocol.sensitivity_policy: Report every fixed halo/observer-host/coverage combination. The eight nonprimary foreground pairs and other coverage levels are descriptive sensitivities; choose no winner and perform no multiple inferential claims.
protocol.source_grouping_boundary: All21 IDs map uniquely to primary Table2 interferometric positions. All210 pairwise separations exceed10 times summed coordinate errors. The primary paper calls its43 discoveries unique sources. Distinct source positions establish grouping, not statistical independence.
protocol.stopping_rule: Execute the21 frozen sources,11/10 partition and all nine predetermined foreground pairs once, then exact deterministic replay. Retain every failure and outcome; change no membership, split, foreground, threshold or model after residual inspection.
protocol.target: Absolute comoving-distance error against the reported spectroscopic redshift labels of the 21 admitted later localized CRAFT/ICS sources.
protocol.transport: The calibration artifact applies as an empirical audit to the admitted cohort. CHIME's400-800MHz selection, FITBURST disk-excess columns and repeated sub-burst rows differ. The study supplies no validated transport or row-exchangeability guarantee for CHIME and no hierarchy-specific evidence.
